text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One was scheduled for an interview
alongside Oguri Cap and Super Creek,
and while accompanying them—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: —What the three of you have achieved over this past year has truly gone down in history. How do you feel about being hailed as the "Eternal Big Three"?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, people started calling me that.
I was a bit taken aback at first, but hey, it doesn't feel bad to be called that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So as for me, to live up to that street name—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...No, that ain't it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
From now on, Lady Inari's just gonna
put on a race way flashier than anyone
ever expected from that street name!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! An impressive comment as expected...! Next, let's hear from Super Creek and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
How do you two feel about this?
Regarding being hailed as part of
the "Eternal Big Three"—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...While we are honored to receive such a wonderful alias from everyone, we also do not intend to become complacent with it.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: I see! Just like Inari One-san, you will continue to pursue running that goes beyond mere titles!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, I don't believe
I'm worthy of being called
one of the 'Big Three' just yet."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
I feel the exact same way as Oguri-chan
about that~.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Meaning...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...We still haven't beaten Inari.
Not in the Mainichi Okan,
nor the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup, and the Arima Kinen too. Inari-chan won them all. At this rate—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
We can't call it the "Big Three" anymore.
Right now, among us, Inari is the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I believe we must take this opportunity
to make our declaration.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Next time, we will defeat Inari-chan.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: And prove that she truly is one of the "Big Three."

text_block_list.name: Venue Uproar
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...!!)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: I-Incredible...! Even now, fierce sparks are still flying between the three of them...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —Daaa-hahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oguri! Creek!
You guys really are the greatest!
That's how it's gotta be, or it's no fun at all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up the win either.
With the title of strongest on the line... let's keep tearing it up in flashy style, whaddya say?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...This is our new festival, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: "You can't have a festival all by yourself"—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Right, Inari-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—To all the reporters who gathered here,
make sure you report this loud and proud!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Our festival—the three of us—
is just getting started!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the fiery interview came to an end,
leaving the public with even higher expectations
for the future feats of Inari One and the others...!
